Appendices

Appendix A — Curriculum Audit / Pseudoscience Audit

Apply an evidence status framework to common movement and wellness claims.

This appendix protects intellectual integrity. Strong teaching requires honest claim labeling.

Evidence status framework

  • Well supported
  • Plausible
  • Speculative
  • Unsupported
  • Contradicted

Claim audit table

| Claim | Status | Responsible framing | |—|—|—| | Progressive load improves adaptation | Well supported | Specify load variables and timescale | | Music supports adherence for many participants | Well supported | Context and preference matter | | Interoception training helps everyone equally | Plausible | Effects vary | | Polyvagal hierarchy explains all trauma response | Speculative | Use as heuristic only | | Fascia stores trauma memory as tissue fact | Unsupported | Frame as metaphor or meaning narrative | | Chakras are anatomical structures | Contradicted | Discuss as symbolic framework | | Sweat detoxifies most toxins | Unsupported | Primary detox pathways are liver and kidney | | Mirror neurons fully explain empathy | Unsupported | Social cognition is multi system |

Script hygiene

Prefer language such as current evidence suggests, in this context, and practitioner wisdom indicates. Avoid science proves when evidence is mixed.

Practicum

  1. Audit one class script claim by claim.
  2. Label every claim by evidence status.
  3. Rewrite unsupported claims into honest alternatives.

Deliverable

Produce a Claim Integrity Sheet with at least twenty five labeled and revised claims.
